desc.zh: 乘海龙马的魔法骑兵，云生于蹄下、魔雨落于枪尖。
desc.en: Magical cavalry mounted upon Sea Longma: cloud gathers beneath their hooves, and a rain of magic falls from their lance-points.

story.zh: 海龙马的来历在任何谱牒与记载里都找不到交代，最初遇到他们的渔人只说台风过后，十几头鬃鬣滴水的灵兽静静立在退潮的礁石上。海龙马的速度比普通巨龙马更加迅捷，其所在之地，上方的空气会渐渐凝结成为云雾。云霄禁卫则可以通过云雾对敌人进行致命的魔法打击。
story.en: No lineage-roll or chronicle accounts for where the Sea Longma came from. The fishermen who first met them said only that once the typhoon had passed, a dozen or so spirit-beasts stood silent upon the ebb-tide rocks, their manes still dripping. Sea Longma are swifter than the common Great Longma, and wherever they are, the air above them slowly thickens into cloud and mist. Through that mist the Empyrean Guard bring a deadly magical stroke down upon their foes.

desc.zh: 海龙马自云中俯冲落地，蹄下掀起一道横贯战线的巨浪。
desc.en: The sea-longma come down out of the cloud, and the shock of their landing throws up a wave that runs the length of the line.
Clouds and mist pour down from the Heavenly River.

desc.zh: 水师的禁卫在阵形完整时攻守皆精
desc.en: While their formation holds, the fleet's guards excel in both attack and defence.

desc.zh: 万物皆应平衡，正所谓暗与明、月与阳、雄与雌一般
desc.en: There must be balance in all things: dark and light, moon and sun, female and male.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以对所有敌军部队引发恐惧，令附近敌军遭受领导力惩罚。同时这支部队自身也对恐惧效果免疫。恐惧惩罚不能叠加
desc.en: This unit frightens all enemy units, reducing their leadership when nearby. It is also immune to fear. Fear penalties do not stack.

desc.zh: 纵使执行的是最令人筋疲力尽的行动，这支部队也永远不会损失体力
desc.en: Even when performing the most fatiguing actions, this unit never loses vigour.

desc.zh: 这支部队免疫心理攻击（恐惧与惊骇）
desc.en: The unit is immune to psychological attacks (Fear & Terror).

desc.zh: 此部队的武道宁和为阳
desc.en: This unit counts as a Yang unit for the purpose of Battle Harmony proximity
